title: Plum Purple Embroidered Cotton Suit Set for Women – Kurta, Pants & Dupatta
color_custom: Plum purple with pink rose & sage embroidery
description:
Regal, rich and made for celebration. This plum-purple cotton suit blooms with oversized pink roses and sage-green leaves across the yoke, with tiny embroidered buttis scattered like stars. Festive enough for Diwali, comfortable enough to wear all day.

✦ The Details
• Straight-cut kurta with band collar, V slit and fabric-covered buttons
• Large rose and leaf thread embroidery on the yoke
• Embroidered buttis across the body and borders on the 3/4 sleeves
• Matching straight pants with an embroidered floral hem
• Soft crushed cotton dupatta with tassels
• Calf-length kurta, 3-piece set

✦ Fabric & Craft
Kurta, pants and dupatta are 100% cotton – soft, breathable and perfect for long festive days indoors and out. The embroidery is done with fine thread in pink, ivory and sage for a rich, dimensional finish.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual size, or use our Fit Finder for a recommendation. Between sizes? Size up for a relaxed look – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your exact measurements at no extra cost.

✦ How to Style It
Oxidised silver jhumkas, a small potli and block heels for Lakshmi puja or a family dinner. For Karva Chauth, add a red bindi and glass bangles. Abroad, a black wool coat over the plum looks striking at evening functions.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in our own Jaipur unit – we send you photos of your piece being made
• Free custom fit – share your measurements and we stitch it for you
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen. Model is wearing size S.
care: Dry clean recommended for the first wash, then gentle hand wash in cold water. Do not wring or bleach. Dry in shade and iron on the reverse side, avoiding the embroidery.
